method: WebSearch (standard) + WebFetch on public pages, no sign-in, no audio download. 'verified' = value read on the fetched page; 'snippet' = value only seen in a search-result summary because the page refused the fetch (403/429). Camelot converted by hand from the stated key. No structure (drop/breakdown/build) timestamps were found for any track.

tracks.file: Alesso - Heroes (we could be) ft. Tove Lo.mp3

sources.site: Promo Only Rhythm Radio DB (Mixmeister analysis)

tracks.notes: BPM 126 unanimous. Key consensus F major (7B) from 3 sources; Mixmeister says G minor (6A, outlier). AcousticBrainz (search snippet only, fetch got 429) reportedly gave D minor (7A, relative of F) with chords key F major. Our file is 294.2 s which matches neither the ~3:30 radio edit nor the 5:39 extended mix (probably the official video audio). Ours 126 / 7B agrees with consensus.

Single source; length 3:50 matches ours (230.4 s). BPM 105 agrees with ours. Key disagrees: source F# minor (11A) vs ours 1B (B major) -- not the relative pair (11A's relative is 11B = A major); 1B is adjacent on the wheel to 12B but two steps from 11A. Single automated source, treat key as low-confidence.

Only a user transcription found (sections Intro/Chorus, no timestamps). Key E minor = 9A agrees with ours. Transcription tempo 128 vs ours 126 -- TheoryTab tempos are user-entered and often approximate; not a strong reference for BPM. No tunebat/songbpm/musicstax page found.
Nothing found for this artist/title on songbpm, tunebat, musicstax, mixgraph, beatport or general search (3 searches + direct songbpm URL 404). Do not use as a web reference.
Single source; length 3:38 matches ours (217.8 s). 128 BPM and E major (12B) both agree with ours.

tracks.file: Martin Garrix - This Dream of You.mp3

sources.site: beatport.com (search snippet; page returned 403 to fetch)

tracks.notes: Length 4:46 matches ours (286.7 s). Key C major (8B) agrees with ours. BPM DISAGREES: both sources say 72 vs ours 128. 72 is not a simple octave of 128 (half-time of 144 would be 72), so either the track is a slow/half-time 72 (=144) song and our tempo is wrong, or the sources are wrong -- worth a listen. Beatport value is only from a search summary that says the page layout made the attribution ambiguous. Release page: https://www.beatport.com/release/this-dream-of-you/7474284 (no BPM/key in snippet).
